description: Raised 7th creates the classic Spanish / metal leading tone.

description: Five notes that almost always sound good over major chords.

description: The rock and blues box — start here for solos.

title: Blues Scale
description: Minor pentatonic plus the flat-5 blue note.

title: Dorian Mode
description: Minor with a raised 6 — Santana, funk, and modal jazz.

title: Phrygian Mode
description: Flat 2 gives a Spanish / metal flavor.

title: Mixolydian Mode
description: Major with flat 7 — rock dominant and jam bands.

title: Locrian Mode
description: Diminished tonic — unstable and rare as a home base.

title: Whole Tone
description: Six equal steps — dreamlike, no leading tone.

title: G Major

title: D Major

title: E Minor
description: Two fingers — often the first minor chord learned.

title: A Minor
description: Open Am — same shape family as E major moved over.
